rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for getting an object back.

example.english: I’m going to reclaim my book.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 lo2 faan1 ngo5 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this when an institution or owner repossesses property, rights, or control rather than simply retrieving an item.

example.english: The bank is going to reclaim our house.
example.traditional: 間銀行要收回我哋間屋。
example.jyutping: gaan1 ngan4 hong4 jiu3 sau1 wui4 ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1

rows.note: Use this for recovering or recycling waste and other recyclable materials.

example.english: These plastic bottles can be taken away to reclaim the plastic.
example.traditional: 呢啲膠樽可以攞去回收。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 gaau1 zeon1 ho2 ji5 lo2 heoi3 wui4 sau1

rows.note: Use this specifically for restoring degraded or abandoned land to usable, usually cultivable, condition.

example.english: Once we reclaim this wasteland, we can grow vegetables here again.
example.traditional: 呢片荒地復墾之後，就可以重新種菜。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin3 fong1 dei6 fuk1 han2 zi1 hau6 zau6 ho2 ji5 cung4 san1 zung3 coi3
